svg.title: A retrieval order through the DaRA warehouse
svg.desc: Worker S04 retrieves order 2904. Nine colored areas act as sources and contain 24 location zones. The active zone and current ground truth activity change at recorded video frame boundaries.
svg.text: A retrieval order through the DaRA warehouse
Worker S04 · Session 2 · Order 2904, execution 3 · 97 observations · 20:26 elapsed
The outline follows the active zone at 30× recording speed.
One full retrieval order in about 41 seconds
Nine source areas · three contain finer zones
Layout adapted from Niemann & Moya Rueda, DaRA Documentation, Fig. 2.42 (CC BY-NC 4.0).
